entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Ps 133:1-3 . The blessings of fraternal unity.

entries.heading: 3. there
entries.text: 3. there --that is, in Zion, the Church; the material Zion, blessed with enriching dews, suggests this allusion the source of the influence enjoyed by the spiritual Zion. commanded the blessing --(Compare Ps 68:28 ).
